_doc: D-132 D1 scope. ids: the per-character fallback, those keep their glb meshes and materials (no surface merge). only: when not empty, just these ids get the merge (D-165: the Afterhours looks; D1 stays parked for every other cast, D-132 addendum 2). Edit, then run build_char_layers.gd, godot --import and assemble_characters.gd (see world/characters/_tools/char_layers.gd).
